mentions.name: AI flat-rate legal billing estimator
mentions.description: A legal-tech AI tool that helps attorneys bill flat-rate instead of hourly. It analyzes attorneys' old time entries to determine the flat-rate price of all of their hourly work, giving them visibility into the cost of upcoming legal work.
mentions.problem: 93% of attorneys bill hourly, primarily because they don't have any sense of the cost of the upcoming work.
mentions.audience: Attorneys and law firms looking to move from hourly to flat-rate billing
mentions.source_excerpt: Legal-tech: Using AI to help attorneys bill flat-rate instead of hourly. It's data intensive, but possible if you go through their old time entries and tell them the flat-rate price of all of their hourly work.
